findings.governingReading: The fatal blow lands from behind after Rider disappears.
findings.explanation: An impact from behind becomes sensing something behind Shirou.

findings.highlight: slices through the back of my neck
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の延髄を串刺しにした
findings.governingReading: From the ceiling, Rider traces a crescent path and pierces Shirou’s medulla or base of the skull through.
findings.explanation: Impaling the medulla becomes slicing through the back of the neck.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの腕のしなりは、本当にキレイだった
findings.governingReading: Even while dying, Shirou perceives the flex and flowing movement of her arm as beautiful.
findings.explanation: The beautiful suppleness of Rider’s arm becomes the beauty of her skills.

findings.evidenceJa: 水仙を愛でるような優雅さ
findings.governingReading: The attack has the grace of admiring or cherishing a daffodil, not necessarily touching it.
findings.explanation: Elegance like appreciating a daffodil becomes caressing one.

findings.evidenceJa: 治療を施せばまだ助かると思います
findings.governingReading: She says she held back and thinks he can still be saved if treatment is applied at this stage.
findings.explanation: Rider’s belief that treatment may still save Shirou becomes a guarantee that he will survive.

findings.governingReading: The narration hears the weighty rattle of chains before Shirou is lifted.
findings.explanation: A heavy chain sound echoing becomes chains approaching.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が少しだけ持ち上げられる
findings.governingReading: His body rises a small amount before Rider looks at his bleeding neck.
findings.explanation: Shirou being lifted only slightly becomes an unspecified full lift.

findings.evidenceJa: あくまで上品に唇を開き
findings.governingReading: The narration stresses that the dark Servant remains thoroughly elegant.
findings.explanation: Rider parting her lips with unwavering refinement becomes doing so slowly.

findings.evidenceJa: 吸血は安楽死に似ていた
findings.governingReading: As consciousness fades without pain, Shirou compares the present experience to euthanasia.
findings.explanation: This blood-draining death resembling euthanasia becomes a general statement about bloodsucking.
